subject: Hourly invoice exports
body:
Hi Sam,

The Quarry Labs changelog from early September says invoice exports now run hourly instead of nightly. I made the same move at Tidewater Freight.

We went from nightly to 15-minute billing exports there, and late invoices fell from 4% to 1%. Your Data Engineer opening lists the export pipeline as the first project.

Would a 15 minute call next week help? If someone else owns this hire, a name is plenty.

Thanks,

R1.text: Quarry Labs changelog, 2026-09-05: moved invoice exports from nightly batch to hourly; export failures dropped to 0.5%.
R1.snippet: moved invoice exports from nightly batch to hourly; export failures dropped to 0.5%

R2.text: Quarry Labs job post, Data Engineer, posted 2026-09-08: the first project is the export pipeline.
R2.snippet: Data Engineer: the first project is the export pipeline
